d: At Rosewood Doha, we create an environment where passion meets purpose – and where careers have meaning.

Guided by our philosophy of Relationship Hospitality and our culture of Make the Place, we believe in enriching lives, starting with yours. We empower you to bring your true self, grow with confidence, curate the extraordinary and leave your legacy.
You’ll be part of a diverse, inclusive and supportive community that invests in your development, celebrates achievements and inspires you to Discover Your Calling.
Together, we push boundaries, explore the uncharted and shape the future of luxury lifestyle experiences.

Rosewood Doha is a landmark destination inspired by Qatar’s coral reefs, bringing together ultra-luxury hospitality, residential living, culinary experiences, holistic wellness, differentiated retail and events within one integrated ecosystem. The property includes a 155-key hotel, 162 serviced apartments and 276 private residences, alongside a diverse collection of restaurants and lounges, expansive event spaces and curated lifestyle experiences. Our destination also houses Asaya, Qatar’s first members-only social wellness club, complemented by Rosewood’s signature Manor Club for Club Room and Suite guests.

Since opening in July of 2025, Rosewood Doha has been recognized with multiple international and regional accolades, including distinctions from the Michelin Guide, Forbes Travel Guide and Qatar Tourism - reflecting the scale, ambition and standards of excellence behind the destination. As part of the global Rosewood Hotels & Resorts portfolio, the property represents a new generation of luxury that goes beyond traditional hospitality into lifestyle, community and experience-driven destinations.

d: World Padel Academy is hiring a Venue Supervisor to lead the daily operations of our Oman venue. You’ll be the main point of contact on site, making sure courts are ready, bookings run smoothly, and players receive a warm, professional welcome from the moment they arrive.
q: Experience supervising teams in venue operations, sports or leisure, hospitality, or a similar customer-facing environment.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage bookings, staffing, and customer needs during busy periods.
Clear communication and the confidence to resolve customer and operational issues as they arise.
Confidence using booking, point-of-sale, and reporting tools, with an understanding of how scheduling and service affect occupancy and revenue.
Experience with PadelMates or Playtomic is an advantage.
If you enjoy leading a team on the floor and building a venue that players want to return to, we’d love to hear from you. Apply through LinkedIn with your CV.
r: Oversee daily venue operations, including opening and closing, court allocation, reception, academy schedules, and facility readiness.
Supervise the front desk and operations teams, coordinate with coaches and support staff, and plan shift coverage around peak hours and events.
Train and support team members, set clear expectations for service, and help resolve issues during shifts.
Handle customer enquiries and complaints, and build relationships with players, members, and corporate clients.
Coordinate tournaments, leagues, socials, camps, and corporate events, from registrations and staffing to court setup.
Track court occupancy, revenue, academy participation, and customer feedback. Use those insights to improve scheduling, increase court usage, and encourage repeat visits.
Keep booking, point-of-sale, and stock records accurate. Coordinate with cleaning and maintenance providers, carry out safety checks, and follow up on issues.
